First announcement

The 12th meeting is planned for 23–24 August 2027 at Macau University of Science and Technology. Basic scientists, clinicians, early-career investigators and postgraduate students are invited to share new work on vascular biology, disease mechanisms and translational research.

Preliminary programme

Pre-meeting activities take place on 22 August. Session times, rooms and dinner arrangements are to be confirmed.

  1. 22AUG
    Sunday

    Pre-meeting activities

    Council Meeting in the afternoon. An invited-guest dinner is planned for the evening.

  2. 23AUG
    Monday

    Scientific sessions · full day

    Scientific lectures, the Young Scholar Forum and posters. A conference dinner is planned for the evening.

  3. 24AUG
    Tuesday

    Scientific sessions · morning

    Scientific presentations and the closing session.

Attendance and registration

Download the attendance form and email your completed copy to the meeting secretariat. Indicate on the form if you need an invitation letter. Formal registration, payment and refund details will follow.

The proposed early-bird deadline is 1 May 2027. Eligibility and fee inclusions will be set out in the formal registration announcement.

Call for abstracts

Abstracts are invited on vascular biology, mechanisms of vascular disease and related translational research. Authors may request an oral or poster presentation. Early-career researchers and postgraduate students are encouraged to take part in the Young Scholar Forum.

An abstract in English is recommended. Include the title, authors, affiliations, abstract, keywords and corresponding author details. Indicate your preferred format on the attendance form. The submission channel and deadline will be announced separately.
